in_english.name: Shukra
in_english.meaning: Name given to a child who expresses gratitude to the Almighty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shukra is derived from the Arabic root word shukr, which means to express gratitude or thankfulness to Allah. It is used in many Islamic names to celebrate the blessings and favors of Allah. Shukra is one of the beautiful names of Allah mentioned in the Quran, mentioned in Surah Fatiha. It is commonly used in Arabic Islamic culture to seek blessings and success. The name Shukra is associated with positive qualities such as gratitude, humility, and thankfulness. In Islamic tradition, the name Shukra is considered a blessing and a source of spiritual growth and development.
